property_summary: After setOwner is called, the stored owner should equal the argument passed to the function.
The owner should be set to the new address after calling setOwner with an admin caller
After a non-admin caller calls setOwner, the owner must remain unchanged.
When the admin calls setOwner, the owner address is updated to the argument passed.
After calling setOwner with any address, the owner state variable equals the address provided.
setOwner always returns true when called by the admin.
C.setOwner returns true when called by admin with any address
setOwner always returns true when called by the admin
setOwner returns true only when called by the admin; otherwise it reverts.
When called by the admin, setOwner returns true and the owner is set to the input address.
For all addresses _owner, after calling setOwner(_owner) the owner equals _owner.
